submission.hypothesis: The Security CAGE turn evidence struct does not structurally retain the model's unresolved epistemic unknowns across the Host-assigned/Runtime-backed turn path. Harness's own AgentRunConclusion model retains unresolved_unknowns and permits candidate_completed to carry honest unknowns (harness tests/test_structured_completion.py:148). But the Security driver collapses the full conclusion down to AgentTurnEvidence.rationale == str(result.conclusion.summary) in both agent_stack.DeepSeekHarnessTurnDriver._run_model (line 851) and host_assigned.HostAssignedDeepSeekHarnessTurnDriver._run_model (line 468) and runtime_assigned path that consumes the same evidence. AgentTurnEvidence (agent_stack.py:136-338) has no unresolved_unknowns field nor any field that structurally carries them; to_dict emits only rationale, so the worker-result/evidence round trip (runtime_worker._execute → evidence.to_dict) likewise loses them. Additionally, host_assigned.run_turn records a hard-coded conclusion={"unresolved_unknowns": []} into the durable Harness run receipt (line 685-690) regardless of what the model actually reported, and both prompt revisions force "unresolved_unknowns MUST be an empty array; describe uncertainty as caveats in the summary." So epistemic unknowns are forced empty at the prompt, dropped at the evidence boundary, never carried through the Runtime worker, and overwritten with [] in the durable Host conclusion—a four-sided projection-loss edge on the Security owner side, not a Harness defect (Harness preserves unknowns end-to-end in its own run store).
submission.causalMechanism: Harness completes with an AgentRunConclusion whose AgentRunConclusion.unresolved_unknowns is populated and serialized (ordivon/model.py:181,203). The Security owner driver reads only result.conclusion.summary into AgentTurnEvidence.rationale and discards result.conclusion.unresolved_unknowns; AgentTurnEvidence has no dedicated field and to_dict never emits one, so the Runtime worker round trip (evidence.to_dict(include_trace=True)) cannot carry unknowns. Host additionally writes a literal {"status":"candidate_completed","summary":...,"unresolved_unknowns":[]} into the durable run conclusion (host_assigned.py:685-690) and both system prompts demand an empty array. Net effect: owned epistemic unknowns are structurally retracted at the Security evidence and Host durable boundaries even though Harness preserved them.
submission.nextFalsifier: Smallest owner-correct falsifier: a multi-turn CAGE run through HostAssignedDeepSeekHarnessTurnDriver (and/or RuntimeBackedHostAssignedDeepSeekHarnessTurnDriver) whose Harness conclusion actually returns a non-empty unresolved_unknowns (as the harness test_structured_completion.py:148 path permits) but whose returned AgentTurnEvidence.to_dict() contains no representation of those unknowns, and whose durable Harness run conclusion records unresolved_unknowns == [] instead of the model's list. That single two-assertion check localizes the loss edge to the Security driver evidence boundary + Host record_run conclusion, without moving Security semantics into Harness or asserting any truth about the model's reasoning. The boundary holds even if one argues the prompt forbids non-empty unknowns, because the durable record_run layer must not silently hard-code [] while the caller's later IF2/real-path consumer (cli_deliberation_before_authority_if2_acceptance.py:120) reads result.conclusion.unresolved_unknowns directly from the Harness adapter and preserves them—demonstrating the owner asymmetry.
